name: Muah AI
summary: Uncensored companion app with chat, image, voice, and phone-call features. The 2024 data breach belongs in the buying decision.

pricing.notes: Removed from major app stores; Android is a sideloaded APK. Confirm current features on the subscription screen.

cons: 2024 data breach: 1.9M emails + prompts exposed (HIBP/404 Media)
Scam-hunt verdict: avoid - breach + astroturfing make it the least trustworthy reputation in the set
